label: Token-at-line replay over the 36 live catalog anchors: 11 expose an extractable identifier, 3 pass, 8 fire. Adjudication: 3 clear stale anchors (advisor-tool-schemas.ts:221 cited where compiledRoute is declared at 268; advisor-status.ts:89-94 cited where the diagnostic-only/repair comment is at 344-345; skill-advisor-cli.ts:1420-1440 cited where the -32602/includeCompiledRoute handling is at 1500-1501), 4 approximate/loose anchors (advisor-recommend.ts:500-510 vs the option gate at 551; skill-advisor-cli-fallback.ts:230 vs includeCompiledRoute:false at 221; advisor-tool-schemas.ts:227 where the file carries no request-option token; skill-advisor-cli-manifest.ts:40 vs the option declaration at 57), and 1 known true positive (code-standards-alignment.md:76). Seven of 8 live fires sit in the system-skill-advisor catalog; multi-anchor lines (advisor-recommend.md:33 cites four files; canonical-first-spec-root-resolution.md:67 and :69 two each) make per-line token binding false-positive-prone, and 25/36 anchors carry no extractable token, so the tier is silent on two-thirds of the corpus. The claim-token advisory posture (nothing fail-closed) is strengthened, not weakened.

Existence tier over 263 catalog files: 1426 path citations, only 8 unresolved instances (4 distinct, 0.56%), all explainable — 2 instances of memory-indexer.ts annotated '(removed with the memory server)' (core-workflow-infrastructure.md:58, retirement note :19); 3 instances of the committed dangling symlink .opencode/plugins/sk-vision.js (catalog documents it as a symlink at feature-catalog.md:248; target vision-runtime/dist/plugin.js unbuilt); 2 instances of the absent .skilled/commands/memory/save.md (json-primary-deprecation-posture.md:44; no memory directory exists — the one candidate move-drift); 1 absent create-diagram-auto.yaml (type-selection-and-routing.md:47; sibling create-<mode>-auto.yaml assets exist). A first run of the same scan reported 34 distinct unresolved because its extractor ordered js before json and truncated .json citations to .js (e.g. packet-authored-registry-routing.md:41 cites mode-registry.json); with boundary-aware extension matching there are zero missing .json citations. The existence half needs boundary-aware extension matching plus an expected-unresolved convention, not a generated-artifact policy.

Coverage boundary: validate-playbook-package.cjs defaults skillsRoot to <repo>/.skilled/skills (line 81) and discovers packages only under it, while the two .pi/extensions playbook trees (23 scenarios) are referenced by no workflow and no validator file; playbook-operator-contract.yml runs the validator at line 61 and routing-registry-drift.yml watches only .skilled/skills/*/manual-testing-playbook/** (lines 54-55). The sampled extension scenarios exercise pi-CLI options (--model, --fast), i.e. non-repo executables the option check skips by design, so the boundary is defensible but must be stated as coverage, not absorbed.

.skilled/specs is a symlink to ../specs, so a .skilled/** catalog glob traverses into specs/**/z_archive and double-counts archive copies: the scan found 58 anchors in 8 files, of which 22 are the z_archive mirror of the live 36 (canonical-first-spec-root-resolution.md and code-standards-alignment.md copies under .skilled/specs/system-speckit/z_archive/022-hybrid-rag-fusion/...). Corpus scans must scope to .skilled/skills/** or exclude z_archive; .skilled/plugins -> ../.opencode/plugins carries the same caveat.

Adjacent staging precedent: routing-registry-drift.yml already scores every hub's compiled decisions against the routing gold its playbook authors, running compiled-route-admission.cjs --all --warn-only (lines 173-180) and documenting the warn-only posture as pending the first baseline triage (lines 174-177). A warning-first rollout with a triaged baseline is an accepted pattern in this repository, relevant to staging the proposed checks.
